description: One reference brand or design system to work from: its verified palette with roles and usage, typefaces with free alternatives, tokens (type scale, spacing, radius, grid, motion), principles and sources. format "skill" returns a SKILL.md an assistant can follow (or the user can save), "prompt" a short paste-in prompt, "data" the raw values. Make the user's own work in its spirit; never copy logos or trademarks.

slug.description: The system's slug, e.g. "aesop" or "ibm-carbon". Get one from list_brand_systems.

name: get_brand_system
